title: dactylorhiza latifolia var. longifolia
intro: Dactylorhiza latifolia var. longifolia, commonly known as the spotted orchid, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the orchid family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza latifolia var. longifolia include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention, and its potential to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
